title: Apple Wallet (.pkpass) Inspector & Validator Specification
description: Formal contract definition and validation rules for Apple PassKit .pkpass packages, schemas, assets, PKCS#7 signatures, and Google Wallet mapping.

ERR_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.title: SHA-1 Manifest Hash Mismatch
ERR_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.description: File content does not match the recorded SHA-1 hash in manifest.json.

ERR_MISSING_MANIFEST_ENTRY.title: File Not in Manifest
ERR_MISSING_MANIFEST_ENTRY.description: A file exists in the archive but is not registered in manifest.json.

ERR_MISSING_ARCHIVE_FILE.title: Missing Archive File
ERR_MISSING_ARCHIVE_FILE.description: A file is declared in manifest.json but missing from the zip archive.

ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_KEY.title: Missing Required Top-Level Key
ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_KEY.description: A mandatory key (such as passTypeIdentifier, teamIdentifier, organizationName) is missing.

ERR_INVALID_PASS_STYLE.title: Invalid Pass Style
ERR_INVALID_PASS_STYLE.description: Pass must define exactly one pass style dictionary (boardingPass, eventTicket, coupon, storeCard, generic).

ERR_INVALID_TRANSIT_TYPE.title: Invalid Transit Type
ERR_INVALID_TRANSIT_TYPE.description: Boarding pass requires a valid transitType (e.g. PKTransitTypeAir, PKTransitTypeTrain).

ERR_INVALID_DATE_TIMEZONE.title: Missing Date Timezone
ERR_INVALID_DATE_TIMEZONE.description: iOS drops passes with dates missing an explicit ISO 8601 timezone offset (e.g. 2026-08-23T14:30:00+02:00 or Z).

ERR_INVALID_BARCODE_ENCODING.title: Unsupported Barcode Encoding
ERR_INVALID_BARCODE_ENCODING.description: Barcode messageEncoding must be iso-8859-1 or utf-8.

ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_ASSET.title: Missing Required Asset
ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_ASSET.description: Apple Wallet requires icon.png (or icon@2x.png) to be present in the bundle.

ERR_MISSING_SIGNATURE.title: Missing PKCS#7 Signature
ERR_MISSING_SIGNATURE.description: iOS PassKit requires a valid digital signature file.

ERR_EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.title: Expired Signing Certificate
ERR_EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.description: The Apple Pass Type ID certificate embedded in the PKCS#7 signature has expired.

WARN_LOW_COLOR_CONTRAST.title: Low Color Contrast
WARN_LOW_COLOR_CONTRAST.description: Foreground or label color has low contrast against the background (< 3.0:1 ratio).

WARN_MISSING_RETINA_ASSET.title: Missing Retina Asset
WARN_MISSING_RETINA_ASSET.description: Asset does not provide an @2x or @3x high-resolution counterpart.

INFO_LOCALIZATION_PRESENT.title: Localizations Detected
INFO_LOCALIZATION_PRESENT.description: Pass contains localized strings tables (.lproj folders).
